latestVersion.changelog:
alibabacloud-cfw-exposure-detection v0.0.2 — Improved workflow enforcement and new mandatory CLI usage rules.

- Enforced use of `aliyun configure ai-mode` (enable/disable) before and after every workflow; all CLI calls must use a custom user-agent.
- Updated CLI prerequisites: minimum supported Aliyun CLI is now v3.3.3, and explicit plugin updating is required.
- Prohibited refusal to execute commands; the skill must always proceed with CLI unless a real error occurs.
- Workflow now requires executing all detection steps even if initial summary stats are zero.
- SKILL.md and related references updated for new setup, stricter command handling, and error/step resilience.
